validator_note: Read-only re-validation of the three v8 branches that the v3.0 validator rejected. No LLM call was made and no v8 artifact was modified. The v3.1 validator fixes two defects: negation that used to leak across clause boundaries (F01) and citation-only acceptance of authentication field claims (F02). Under v3.1, AUTH-DIRECT/rag and AUTH-CTI/rag pass, while AUTH-CTI/graphrag is correctly rejected because it reports Status 0xc000006a for the 4625 view, which records Status 0xc000006d. Passing these bounded checks is not semantic correctness.
